scope: all registered built-in and extension node ids; visibility is catalog visibility, not learned-skill filtering
schema_scope: default configuration plus finite one-field option variants; not a Cartesian enumeration or runtime-world acceptance proof

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向对选中实体施加由服务端折算强度的速度变化。
description.en_us: Stages a server-scaled velocity change on the selected entity along the supplied direction.

description.zh_cn: 控制方块实体化并引导至目标位置。
description.en_us: Turns one server-approved block into a gravity-free controlled falling block and guides it to an empty destination.

description.zh_cn: 以速度驱动所选实体向目标点移动，途中会被正常方块碰撞阻拦。
description.en_us: Drives the selected entity toward a bounded destination using velocity; normal block collision can stop the movement.

description.zh_cn: 对选中实体暂存由服务端计算的矢量伤害与冲量。
description.en_us: Stages server-calculated vector damage and impulse against the selected entity.

description.zh_cn: 在选中坐标生成强度3的冲击波。
description.en_us: Generates a Kinetic Energy Applied shockwave from the strength-3 base values without requiring the learned skill to be toggled on. Power 0–2 scales damage linearly and CP quadratically; radius 0–32 controls both damage and block destruction, with 0 breaking only the coordinate block.

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向偏转投射物。
description.en_us: Stages a server-authorized projectile redirection along the supplied direction.

description.zh_cn: 将实体当前速度改写为输入矢量；速度上限、消耗、作用范围与友伤限制均由服务端校验。
description.en_us: Rewrites an entity's velocity to the supplied vector; the server enforces speed, cost, range, and friendly-fire limits.

description.zh_cn: 为选中的整结构取得本程序的独占控制。后续单体动作连接“结构控制”端口；结构集合动作会自行取得并释放控制，无须逐个调用本节点。结构被占用、已卸载或已断裂失效时操作失败。
description.en_us: Acquire exclusive control of one whole structure for this program. Connect its Control output to single-structure actions. Group actions acquire and release their own control. Busy, unloaded or stale structures are rejected.

description.zh_cn: 按所选蓄力档位与可选格数预算，对选中宿主方块启动统一的暂存捕获事务。结构输出仅在内容事务提交后发布；空选区、被占、超预算与权限不足均返回机器可读的明确结果并保留源方块。
description.en_us: Starts the shared staged capture transaction on the selected host block using the chosen charge tier and optional cell budget. The structure output appears only after the content transaction committed; pending, empty, occupied, over-budget and permission failures are reported as explicit machine-readable results and keep the source blocks.

label.zh_cn: 格数预算（0 为后端默认）
label.en_us: Cell budget (0 is the backend default)

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向按强度发射整结构。沿实际飞行路径的 64 格增强窗口破坏可破坏方块；有效实体命中或硬障碍实际碰撞可触发爆破并产生真实碎片掉落。受保护或不可用区域会停止增强，未碰撞而到期时保留结构与自然运动。
description.en_us: Launch the whole structure along the input direction at the selected strength. Break eligible blocks during a 64-block actual-travel window. A valid entity hit or real hard-obstacle impact may blast the structure into normal drops. Protected or unavailable terrain stops the enhancement; expiry without impact preserves the structure and natural motion.

description.zh_cn: 向世界目标坐标持续施力；可选局部锚点指定结构上的作用位置，不接目标时保持该锚点当前的位置。持续秒数优先使用输入端口，其次使用配置。等待施力窗口结束后继续，并回传原控制供后续动作使用。实际位移取决于质量、碰撞和推力。
description.en_us: Apply force toward a world destination. An optional local anchor chooses the point on the structure; without a destination, hold that anchor at its initial world position. The Seconds input overrides the configured duration. Wait for the force window, then pass the original Control to the next action. Motion depends on mass, collisions and available force.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。选取最多 8 个空闲结构，为各成员设置“初始质心＋世界位移”目标并同时施力。位移最长 64 格，持续 0.1–10 秒；秒数输入优先于配置，开始后固定目标与时长。等待施力窗口结束后释放控制，输出原结构集合供后续动作使用；保留惯性，到达位置由实际物理运动决定。 不接位移时默认沿视线引导 3 格，默认持续 1 秒。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Apply force to at most 8 free structures, targeting each initial center of mass plus the world displacement. Maximum distance: 64 blocks; duration: 0.1–10 seconds. Seconds overrides the configuration; targets and duration are captured once. Wait for the force window, release control, then output the original set. Inertia remains and physical motion determines the final position. With no displacement input, guide 3 blocks along the caster’s view for the default 1 second.

description.zh_cn: 结束本控制句柄的持续施力与姿态命令，保留结构、线速度和角速度。重复释放无额外效果；后续需要控制时重新取得，不会影响接替本句柄的新控制。
description.en_us: Stop this control handle’s force and attitude commands while preserving the structure and its linear and angular velocity. Repeated release has no additional effect. Acquire a new handle for later actions; a successor’s control is preserved.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别按配置回正。自动取得控制，等待全组完成后释放，并输出原结构集合。各成员分别使用自己的创建姿态；任一成员失效或受阻时结束全组。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Right up to 8 free structures independently using the configured reference. Acquire control automatically, wait for all members, release control, then output the original set. Each member uses its own creation attitude. Stop if any member becomes invalid or obstructed.

description.zh_cn: 按配置回到世界竖直方向或创建时的姿态；创建姿态不可用时按配置失败或改用世界网格。等待回正后继续，并回传原控制。超时、受阻或控制失效时结束操作。
description.en_us: Return to world upright or the structure’s creation attitude. If the creation attitude is unavailable, reject or use the world grid as configured. Wait until finished, then pass on the original Control. Stop on timeout, obstruction or lost control.

description.zh_cn: 将结构转向输入的世界绝对姿态；姿态由旋转轴与弧度角构造。受力矩和碰撞约束，等待达到目标后继续，并回传原控制供下一动作使用。只控制朝向，不负责抬升或悬停。
description.en_us: Turn the structure toward the world-absolute attitude constructed from an axis and an angle in radians. Wait until reached, then pass the original Control output to the next action. Torque and collision limits apply. This action controls attitude without providing lift or hovering.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别转向同一世界绝对姿态。自动取得控制，等待全组完成后释放，并输出原结构集合；每体独立绕质心旋转，不绕群组中心公转。任一成员失效或受阻时结束全组。 不接姿态时默认转向世界 Y 轴 90°。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Turn up to 8 free structures to the same world-absolute attitude. Acquire control automatically, wait for all members, release control, then output the original set. Each rotates about its own center of mass. Stop the group if any member becomes invalid or obstructed. With no attitude input, use an absolute 90° rotation about world Y.

description.zh_cn: 按世界轴或结构自身轴旋转指定时间；正负角速度决定旋转方向，单位为弧度/秒。服务器上限为每秒 2 弧度、58 秒。结束时按配置制动或保留惯性，再回传原控制；不负责悬停。
description.en_us: Rotate about a world axis or the structure’s local axis. Signed angular speed sets direction in radians per second. Server limits: 2 rad/s and 58 seconds. Brake or preserve inertia as configured, then pass on the original Control. No hovering is provided.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别绕世界轴或自身局部轴持续旋转。自动取得控制，在结束时按配置制动或保留惯性，随后释放并输出原结构集合；每体分别计费，不提供队形约束或悬停。 不接旋转轴时默认世界向上；默认每秒 1 弧度，持续 1 秒。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Spin up to 8 free structures independently about a world or local axis. Acquire control automatically, brake or preserve inertia as configured, then release and output the original set. Costs apply per member; formation and hovering are not provided. The default axis is world up, at 1 rad/s for 1 second.

description.zh_cn: 检查结构能否按当前朝向还原到世界方块网格。目标必须已加载、可放置且具有权限；当前版本只提供检查，尚不执行还原。使用“释放结构控制”可结束能力控制并保留物理结构。
description.en_us: Check whether the structure can align with the world block grid at its current attitude. The destination must be loaded, placeable and permitted. This version only checks conditions; restoration is not yet available. Release Structure Control ends ability control while preserving the physical structure.

description.zh_cn: 施放该分类的能力时，从此处启动该能力分类的程序。
description.en_us: Starts this ability category's program when an ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 将期望现象减去观测现象，输出需要写入个人现实的修正矢量及其模长。
description.en_us: Subtracts the observed phenomenon from the expected one and outputs the correction vector and its magnitude.

description.zh_cn: 按接触面的单位法线反射入射矢量，同时保留原矢量模长。
description.en_us: Reflects an incident vector around a unit surface normal while preserving its magnitude.

description.zh_cn: 返回执行当前矢量操作精密操作的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this vector-manipulation program.

description.zh_cn: 返回当前正在威胁能力者的投射物。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified projectiles currently threatening the caster.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者准星下实体。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity under the caster's crosshair.

description.zh_cn: 使用气动力沿输入方向推动实体，也可将能力者自身作为目标。
description.en_us: Pushes a server-verified entity, including the caster, along the supplied direction using bounded pneumatic force.

description.zh_cn: 为实体集合逐一计算指向中心坐标的风向并施加风压，可用于聚怪、打断和制造碰撞或坠落伤害。
description.en_us: Calculates a wind direction toward the center for each entity, enabling grouping, interruption, collision, and fall damage.

description.zh_cn: 激活所有已放置的射流喷口；临时喷口会在本次喷射结束后移除。
description.en_us: Activates every placed jet nozzle; temporary nozzles are removed when this firing cycle ends.

description.zh_cn: 从可选始发点沿输入方向释放层流空气刃；蓄力加速可用 CP 换时间，刃面可保持默认、由方向向量确定或每次施放随机旋转。
description.en_us: Launches a laminar air blade from the optional origin. Charge acceleration trades CP for time; the blade plane may stay at its default, follow a direction input, or rotate randomly per cast.

description.zh_cn: 统一结构节点族的旧式入口：以已安装喷口的方块为外表面中心，选取向内偏移的球形结构并按质量施加反向推力。旧图的端口与配置保持不变，并在加载或导入时迁移到统一的结构提取、获取控制与发射节点；新图请直接使用统一节点。
description.en_us: Legacy form of the unified structure family: treats the nozzle support as the outer face center of an inward-shifted sphere before mass-aware reverse thrust is applied. Old graphs keep their ports and configuration and are migrated into the unified extraction, control and launch nodes when loaded or imported; new graphs should use the unified nodes directly.

description.zh_cn: 在方块对应方向的面或实体上放置朝向输入方向的临时射流喷口。
description.en_us: Places a temporary nozzle on the direction-facing side of a block or on an entity, aimed along the supplied direction.

description.zh_cn: 为选中的整结构取得本程序的独占控制。后续单体动作连接“结构控制”端口；结构集合动作会自行取得并释放控制，无须逐个调用本节点。结构被占用、已卸载或已断裂失效时操作失败。 须有本人有效喷口；各喷口共用整结构推力额度。

Busy, unloaded or stale structures are rejected. Requires the caster’s valid mounted nozzles, which share one force budget per structure.

description.zh_cn: 在所选宿主方块上启动以喷口为入口的分阶段捕获事务，使用所选捕获半径与可选格数预算；喷口支撑格必须能解析到实际捕获结构格。只有内容事务提交后才会发布结构输出，PENDING 与被拒绝的捕获都不发布引用并保留源方块。
description.en_us: Starts the nozzle-hosted staged capture transaction on the selected host block with the chosen capture radius and optional cell budget. The nozzle support cell must resolve to a captured structure cell. The structure output appears only after the content transaction committed; pending and rejected captures publish no reference and keep the source blocks.

label.zh_cn: 格数预算（0 为后端默认）
label.en_us: Cell budget (0 is the backend default)

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向对已捕获喷口实施一次有界发射。每个喷口的局部推力方向随完整姿态逐步变换，整结构共享的有限力预算不会因喷口数量而复制；伤害只在真实接触时结算，绝不预结算整条轨迹。
description.en_us: Engages the captured nozzles for one bounded launch along the supplied direction. Every nozzle's local thrust direction follows the live full pose each step, the shared whole-body force budget is never multiplied by the nozzle count, and damage is settled only at real contacts, never along a preset trajectory.

description.en_us: Counts the caster's block nozzles in range. When a direction is connected, only nozzles within forty-five degrees are counted.

description.en_us: Returns the player executing this Aeromanip program.

description.en_us: Wraps one entity as an entity set for filters and actions.

description.zh_cn: 从集合中移除一个指定实体。
description.en_us: Removes one specified entity from a set.

description.zh_cn: 选取距离能力者最远的实体。
description.en_us: Selects the entity farthest from the caster.

description.zh_cn: 选取生命百分比最高的实体。
description.en_us: Selects the entity with the highest health percentage.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留同时存在于两个集合中的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities present in both input sets.

description.zh_cn: 按照稳定顺序保留不超过设定数量的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps at most the selected number of entities in stable order.

description.zh_cn: 选取生命百分比最低的实体。
description.en_us: Selects the entity with the lowest health percentage.

description.zh_cn: 选取距离能力者最近的实体。
description.en_us: Selects the entity nearest to the caster.

description.zh_cn: 由服务端从集合中随机选取一个实体。

description.zh_cn: 按照与能力者的距离排列实体集合。
description.en_us: Sorts a set by distance from the caster.

description.zh_cn: 从左集合移除右集合包含的所有实体。

description.zh_cn: 合并两个集合并移除重复实体。
description.en_us: Combines two sets and removes duplicate entities.

description.zh_cn: 将可配置的数据写入聊天栏；文本中的 {value} 会替换为输入数据，并可选择仅自己或全体玩家可见。

label.zh_cn: 输出文本（{value} 代表数据）

description.zh_cn: 判断方块坐标集合是否包含指定坐标。

description.zh_cn: 保留同时存在于两个集合中的方向。
description.en_us: Keeps directions present in both sets.

description.zh_cn: 从输入方向集合中由服务端随机选取一个方向；空集合不输出方向。
description.en_us: Selects one server-random direction from the supplied set. An empty set produces no output.

description.zh_cn: 保留同时存在于两个集合中的实体。

description.zh_cn: 从实体集合中选取与输入世界坐标距离最近的实体；忽略其他维度或已失效的实体，空集合不输出实体。

description.zh_cn: 从输入实体集合中由服务端随机选取一个实体；空集合不输出实体。

description.zh_cn: 将实体、世界坐标或方块坐标集合按其到输入世界坐标的距离正序或倒序排列。

description.en_us: Tests whether an structure set contains the supplied structure.

description.zh_cn: 从左侧结构集合中移除右侧集合内的全部结构。
description.en_us: Removes every structure in the right set from the left set.

description.en_us: Runs the body once for each structure, then continues through Done.

description.en_us: Returns the structure at the supplied collection position, starting at 1.

description.zh_cn: 保留同时存在于两个集合中的结构。
description.en_us: Keeps structures present in both sets.

name.zh_cn: 集合中距选取点最近结构

description.zh_cn: 从结构集合中选择距输入世界坐标最近的结构；忽略已卸载、已失效、其他维度或超出能力查询范围的引用；等距时保留集合顺序。
description.en_us: Choose the closest structure in a set, ignoring unloaded, stale, other-dimension or out-of-range references. Ties retain set order.

description.en_us: Wraps one structure in a set.

description.zh_cn: 返回集合中的结构数量。

description.en_us: Tests whether a world-position set contains the supplied position.

description.zh_cn: 保留同时存在于两个集合中的世界坐标。
description.en_us: Keeps world positions present in both sets.

description.zh_cn: 从输入世界坐标集合中由服务端随机选取一个坐标；空集合不输出坐标。
description.en_us: Selects one server-random world position from the supplied set. An empty set produces no output.

description.zh_cn: 将一个世界坐标包装为集合。
description.en_us: Wraps one world position in a set.

description.zh_cn: 返回集合中的世界坐标数量。
description.en_us: Returns the number of world positions in the set.

description.zh_cn: 合并两个世界坐标集合并移除重复项。
description.en_us: Combines two world-position sets and removes duplicates.

description.zh_cn: 按逗号分隔的方块标签（以 # 开头）、注册名或显示名称精确保留方块坐标。
description.en_us: Keeps block positions matching comma-separated block tags (prefixed with #), registry names, or exact display names.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留存活且未被移除的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities that are alive and have not been removed.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留与参照实体结盟的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities allied with the supplied reference entity.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留与中心坐标处于同一维度且不超过指定半径的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities in the center's dimension and within the supplied radius.

description.zh_cn: 按逗号分隔的实体类型标签（以 # 开头）、注册名或显示名称精确保留实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities matching comma-separated entity-type tags (prefixed with #), registry names, or exact display names.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留当前持有攻击目标的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps mobs that currently have an attack target.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留当前生命值百分比不低于输入值的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities whose current health percentage is at least the input.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留当前生命值百分比不高于输入值的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities whose current health percentage is at most the input.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留会攻击参照实体或最近被其伤害的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities that can attack the reference or were recently hurt by it.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留最近被指定攻击者伤害的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities most recently damaged by the supplied attacker.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留最大生命值不低于输入数值的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities whose maximum health is at least the supplied value.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留最大生命值不高于输入数值的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps living entities whose maximum health is at most the supplied value.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留当前攻击目标为指定实体的生物。
description.en_us: Keeps mobs whose current attack target is the supplied entity.

description.zh_cn: 按检查器配置过滤全部、生命体、玩家、生物、敌对生物、动物、友善生物、投射物或物品实体。
description.en_us: Filters by any, living, player, mob, hostile, animal, friendly, projectile, or item as selected in the inspector.

description.zh_cn: 仅保留指定观察者拥有直接视线的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities with direct line of sight from the supplied observer.

name.zh_cn: 按方块或标签筛选结构
name.en_us: Filter structures by block or tag

description.zh_cn: 输入逗号分隔的方块 ID 或 #方块标签；可匹配任意非空气方块，或要求所有非空气方块均匹配列表。包括液体和装饰。完整包围盒超过 4096 格或无法完整读取时排除；不会加载区块或取得控制权。
description.en_us: Accepts comma-separated block IDs or #block tags. Match any non-air cell, or require every non-air cell to match the list, including fluids and decorations. Excludes incomplete reads or bounds over 4096 cells. Never loads chunks or acquires control.

description.zh_cn: 保留结构集合中到输入世界坐标的碰撞形状距离不超过半径的有效结构。不会取得结构控制权。
description.en_us: Keep valid structures whose collision geometry is within the radius of the world point. Does not acquire control.

description.zh_cn: 按技能来源标记、本人创建、技能 ID 或技能碎片筛选。未标记只接受健康账本确认的结果；来源信息不代表控制权限。
description.en_us: Filters by skill provenance, caster attribution, skill ID or skill fragment. Unmarked requires a healthy ledger. Provenance does not grant control permission.

description.zh_cn: 从集合中移除失效、已卸载、其他维度或超出能力查询范围的结构，保留原顺序。
description.en_us: Removes stale, unloaded, other-dimension and out-of-range structures while preserving order.

description.zh_cn: 根据条件将控制流程送入成立或不成立分支。
description.en_us: Sends control flow through True or False according to the condition.

description.zh_cn: 结束最近一层 foreach 循环，并从其“完成”端口继续。
description.en_us: Ends the nearest enclosing foreach loop and continues through its Done output.

description.zh_cn: 跳过最近一层 foreach 循环体的剩余流程并开始下一轮。
description.en_us: Skips the remainder of the nearest enclosing foreach body and starts its next iteration.

description.zh_cn: 停止当前程序执行路径。
description.en_us: Stops the current program execution path.

description.zh_cn: 收到符合消息来源和关键词条件的玩家聊天时触发；任意消息模式不检查关键词。
description.en_us: Starts when player chat matches the sender and keyword settings. Any message ignores the keyword.

description.zh_cn: 生命值首次越过配置的上限或下限阈值时触发；离开触发区间后自动复位，之后可再次触发。
description.en_us: Triggers once when health first enters the configured above/below threshold region, then rearms after health leaves that region.

description.zh_cn: 玩家受到的攻击被接受后、伤害实际结算前启动此自定义技能。
description.en_us: Starts this custom skill after an incoming attack is accepted but before its damage is applied.

description.zh_cn: 按配置的 0–1200 tick 固定间隔启动；默认 40 tick。循环不再额外放大行动消耗，更快的触发间隔会自然累积更多 CP 占用。
description.en_us: Starts at a fixed 0–1200 tick interval, defaulting to 40 ticks. Looping does not add an extra action-cost multiplier; faster intervals naturally accumulate more CP occupation.

description.zh_cn: 玩家对目标进行近战攻击后启动此自定义技能。
description.en_us: Starts this custom skill after the caster performs a melee attack against a target.

description.zh_cn: 发生配置的运动动作时启动此自定义技能，也可手动触发。
description.en_us: Starts this custom skill when the configured movement action occurs. It can also be started manually.

description.zh_cn: 将当前程序挂起 1–72000 tick，随后从“流程”端口继续，期间不会阻塞服务器 tick。
description.en_us: Suspends this program for 1–72000 ticks, then continues from Flow without blocking the server tick.

description.en_us: Adds two arbitrary-precision integers.

description.zh_cn: 返回左侧任意精度整数除以右侧整数的商。

description.zh_cn: 判断两个方块坐标是否指向同一维度中的同一方块。
description.en_us: Tests whether two block positions identify the same block in the same dimension.

description.zh_cn: 仅当两个输入均为真时返回真。
description.en_us: Returns true only when both inputs are true.

description.zh_cn: 反转一个布尔值。
description.en_us: Inverts a boolean value.

description.zh_cn: 任一输入为真时返回真。
description.en_us: Returns true when either input is true.

description.zh_cn: 恰有一个输入为真时返回真。
description.en_us: Returns true when exactly one input is true.

description.zh_cn: 判断两个方向的各分量是否相等。
description.en_us: Tests whether two directions have equal components.

description.zh_cn: 判断两个引用是否指向同一实体。
description.en_us: Tests whether two references identify the same entity.

description.zh_cn: 将两个浮点数相加。
description.en_us: Adds two floating-point values.

description.zh_cn: 返回左侧浮点数除以右侧浮点数的商。
description.en_us: Divides the left floating-point value by the right one.

description.en_us: Tests whether two floating-point values are equal.

description.en_us: Tests whether the left floating-point value is greater than or equal to the right one.

description.en_us: Tests whether the left floating-point value is less than the right one.

description.en_us: Tests whether the left floating-point value is less than or equal to the right one.

description.en_us: Returns the remainder after dividing the left floating-point value by the right one.

description.en_us: Subtracts the right floating-point value from the left one.

description.en_us: Adds two 32-bit integers.

description.en_us: Divides the left integer by the right one.

description.en_us: Subtracts the right integer from the left one.

description.en_us: Calculates the left and right inputs using the numeric type and arithmetic operator selected in the inspector.

description.en_us: Compares the left and right inputs using the numeric type and operator selected in the inspector.

description.zh_cn: 在整数、大整数和浮点数之间转换；浮点数转整数时向零取整，超出目标类型范围时终止执行。
description.en_us: Converts between integer, big integer and float. Float-to-integer conversion truncates toward zero; out-of-range results stop execution.

description.zh_cn: 根据“条件”返回“为真值”或“为假值”，两者的数据类型由检查器统一选择。
description.en_us: Returns the True Value or False Value according to Condition. The inspector selects the shared value type.

description.zh_cn: 按配置判断文本相等、包含、开头或结尾，结果可连接流程分支。
description.en_us: Compares text by equality, containment, prefix, or suffix; connect the result to a flow branch.

description.zh_cn: 按所选规则取出指定片段，并输出片段总数和是否存在。序号从 0 起；自定义分隔符按原文匹配。
description.en_us: Split by the chosen rule. Returns a fragment, count and existence. Indices start at 0; custom delimiters are literal.

description.zh_cn: 判断两个世界坐标的数值与维度是否均相等。
description.en_us: Tests whether two world positions have equal coordinates and dimensions.

description.zh_cn: 按配置检测实体视线或世界坐标与方向命中的方块面，并输出该面的对外法向量。
description.en_us: Raycasts from an entity's view or from a world position and direction, then outputs the hit face's outward normal.

description.zh_cn: 将两个同维度方块坐标作为对角点，输出所构成立方体内的全部方块坐标。
description.en_us: Uses two same-dimension block positions as opposite corners and outputs every block position inside the resulting cuboid.

description.zh_cn: 返回正在执行当前能力程序的能力者。
description.en_us: Returns the caster executing the current ability program.

description.zh_cn: 按距最新消息的条数、字符起点和长度截取聊天文本；不存在时输出空文本与假。
description.en_us: Slices a chat message by history distance, character start, and length; returns empty text and false if absent.

description.zh_cn: 读取启动当前程序的聊天消息；等待后仍保持同一文本。
description.en_us: Reads the chat message that started this program, even after a wait.

description.zh_cn: 在“受击时”触发器中返回本次传入伤害值；其他触发器不输出数据。
description.en_us: Returns the current incoming damage amount during a Hurt trigger; other triggers produce no value.

description.zh_cn: 返回触发当前“受击时”程序的攻击实体；在其他触发器中不输出数据。
description.en_us: Returns the entity responsible for the current Hurt trigger; outside that trigger it produces no value.

description.zh_cn: 收集指定世界坐标半径范围内的实体。
description.en_us: Collects entities within the supplied radius of a world position.

description.zh_cn: 读取所选实体的当前生命值、CP 值或 SP 值；CP 与 SP 适用于玩家实体。
description.en_us: Reads the selected entity's current health, CP, or SP. CP and SP are available for player entities.

description.zh_cn: 返回查询范围内实体当前碰撞箱的高度。
description.en_us: Returns the current bounding-box height of an entity within query range.

description.zh_cn: 读取实体当前注视的方向。
description.en_us: Reads the direction an entity is currently looking.

description.zh_cn: 返回保留大小的实体速度向量与速率；实体静止时输出零向量。
description.en_us: Returns the entity's magnitude-preserving velocity vector and speed, including a zero vector while stationary.

description.zh_cn: 输入一个实体，输出其当前速度向量对应的归一化运动方向；实体静止时不输出。
description.en_us: Accepts an entity and outputs the normalized direction of its current velocity; stationary entities produce no output.

description.zh_cn: 按配置读取实体脚下、包围盒中心或眼部的世界坐标。
description.en_us: Reads an entity's feet, bounding-box center, or eye position according to its configuration.

description.zh_cn: 以大整数返回本次程序执行时的服务端游戏 tick。
description.en_us: Returns the server game-time tick for this program execution as a big integer.

description.zh_cn: 选择准星下的整个物理结构。结构引用与普通实体、世界方块坐标分开，卸载后失效。
description.en_us: Selects the complete physical structure under the crosshair. Structure references are separate from entities and world block positions, and expire on unload.

description.zh_cn: 按节点配置返回服务端验证的能力者准星下实体或方块坐标；未命中时不输出数据。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity or block position under the caster's crosshair according to its configuration, or no data on a miss.

description.zh_cn: 返回当前循环触发从 0 开始的执行次数；由其他触发器执行时返回 0。
description.en_us: Returns the zero-based execution count of the current periodic trigger; other trigger types return zero.

description.zh_cn: 返回触发当前“近战时”程序的目标；其他触发器不输出数据。
description.en_us: Returns the target responsible for the current Melee trigger; other triggers produce no value.

description.zh_cn: 在输入世界坐标的指定半径内选取最近的整个物理结构。距离按当前旋转后的碰撞形状计算；没有目标时不输出结构。
description.en_us: Select the nearest loaded structure within the radius of a world point, measured against its rotated collision geometry. No structure output when empty.

description.zh_cn: 从起点沿指定方向查找射程内首个命中的方块。
description.en_us: Finds the first block hit from an origin along a direction within range.

description.zh_cn: 从起点沿指定方向查找射程内首个命中的实体。
description.en_us: Finds the first entity hit from an origin along a direction within range.

description.zh_cn: 读取范围内整结构的世界质心、线速度（格/秒）、角速度（弧度/秒）与总质量。不可用时不输出数据。
description.en_us: Reads the in-range body's world center of mass, linear velocity (blocks/second), angular velocity (radians/second) and total mass. Unavailable bodies produce no data.

description.zh_cn: 判断引用是否属于当前维度、当前激活实例且在能力查询范围内；不会取得控制权。
description.en_us: Checks the current activation, dimension and ability query range without acquiring control.

description.zh_cn: 按输入世界坐标和半径查询已加载物理结构，按到真实碰撞形状的距离由近到远排列。不会加载区块或取得控制权；查询不完整时报告失败。
description.en_us: Find loaded structures within a radius, nearest first by collision-geometry distance. Does not load chunks or acquire control; incomplete coverage fails the query.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的整数方块坐标与维度。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured integer block coordinates and dimension.

description.zh_cn: 将方块坐标分解为整数 X、Y、Z 分量。
description.en_us: Splits a block position into its integer X, Y, and Z components.

description.zh_cn: 在配置的维度中使用整数分量构造方块坐标。
description.en_us: Builds a block position from integer components in the configured dimension.

description.zh_cn: 将方块坐标转换为其中心点的世界坐标。
description.en_us: Converts a block position to the world position at its center.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的方向向量。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured direction vector.

description.zh_cn: 返回从第一个世界坐标指向第二个坐标的归一化方向。
description.en_us: Returns the normalized direction from the first world position to the second.

description.zh_cn: 将方向分解为 X、Y、Z 分量。
description.en_us: Splits a direction into its X, Y, and Z components.

description.zh_cn: 使用三个浮点分量构造并归一化方向。
description.en_us: Builds and normalizes a direction from three floating-point components.

description.zh_cn: 返回两个方向的点积。
description.en_us: Returns the dot product of two directions.

description.zh_cn: 反转一个方向。
description.en_us: Reverses a direction.

description.zh_cn: 将世界坐标向下取整为其所在方块的坐标。
description.en_us: Rounds a world position down to its containing block position.

description.zh_cn: 将结构引用与其内部方块坐标绑定；移动节点控制该方块中心。坐标从提取区域最小角开始，不是世界坐标。
description.en_us: Bind a structure reference to a local block coordinate. Move controls that block's center. Coordinates start at the capture area's minimum corner, not at the world origin.

description.zh_cn: 由旋转轴和弧度角构建绝对目标姿态，连接结构旋转节点的姿态端口。
description.en_us: Build an absolute rotation from an axis and an angle in radians, then connect it to a structure rotate node.

description.zh_cn: 解析三维数值为坐标、向量或方向。支持 ~ 相对与 ^ 局部坐标，基准默认为施术者。失败无结果，请先判断“解析成功”。
description.en_us: Parse a triple as a position, vector or direction. ~ offsets positions; ^ uses local axes. Defaults to the caster. Branch on success before using the result.

description.zh_cn: 按配置对向量、方向或世界坐标执行加减、点叉乘、标量缩放、求长度或归一化。
description.en_us: Performs configurable vector, direction, or world-coordinate addition, subtraction, dot/cross product, scaling, length, or normalization.

description.zh_cn: 将保留长度的向量分解为 X、Y、Z 分量。
description.en_us: Splits a magnitude-preserving vector into its X, Y, and Z components.

description.zh_cn: 使用三个浮点分量构造保留长度的向量。
description.en_us: Builds a magnitude-preserving vector from three floating-point components.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的坐标数值与维度。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured coordinates and dimension.

description.zh_cn: 将世界坐标分解为浮点 X、Y、Z 分量。
description.en_us: Splits a world position into its floating-point X, Y, and Z components.

description.zh_cn: 在配置的维度中使用浮点分量构造世界坐标。
description.en_us: Builds a world position from floating-point components in the configured dimension.

description.zh_cn: 返回两个世界坐标之间的距离。
description.en_us: Returns the distance between two world positions.

description.zh_cn: 沿指定方向将世界坐标移动给定距离。
description.en_us: Moves a world position along a direction by the supplied distance.

description.zh_cn: 判断两个世界坐标是否属于同一维度。
description.en_us: Tests whether two world positions belong to the same dimension.

description.zh_cn: 按名称清除一个跨槽位变量。
description.en_us: Clears one cross-slot variable by name.

description.zh_cn: 清除当前能力分类下所有跨槽位变量。
description.en_us: Clears all cross-slot variables in the current ability category.

description.zh_cn: 按名称读取跨槽位保存的值，并输出是否存在。
description.en_us: Reads a named cross-slot value and whether it exists.

description.zh_cn: 按名称持久保存数值或文本，供其他槽位读取。
description.en_us: Persistently stores a named number, boolean, or text value for other slots.

description.zh_cn: 从当前程序会话读取配置类型的值。
description.en_us: Reads the configured typed value from the current program session.

description.zh_cn: 在当前程序会话中存储类型化数值并继续流程。
description.en_us: Stores a typed value in the current program session and continues flow.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的任意精度整数。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured arbitrary-precision integer.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的真或假。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured true or false value.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的浮点数。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured floating-point value.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的 32 位整数。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured 32-bit integer.

description.zh_cn: 在配置的整数、大整数或浮点数上下限之间生成随机值。
description.en_us: Generates an integer, big integer, or floating-point value between the configured bounds.

description.zh_cn: 输出检查器中配置的 boolean、integer、big_integer 或 float 常量。
description.en_us: Outputs a boolean, integer, big_integer, or float constant selected in the inspector.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的资源标签，也可将带 # 前缀的标签补充给文本配置端口。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured resource tag. It can also supply a text configuration port with its leading # marker.

description.zh_cn: 输出配置的文本值。
description.en_us: Outputs the configured text value.

description.zh_cn: 在所选位置塑造一只需要维持的未元物质独角仙。
description.en_us: Creates one maintained darkmatter beetle at a loaded, collision-free position within the selected range.

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向释放未元物质斩击。
description.en_us: Launches a server-scaled directional darkmatter slash with a bounded cone radius.

description.zh_cn: 分解所选射程内一个方块。
description.en_us: Disassembles one loaded, permitted block within the selected range.

description.zh_cn: 对所选射程内一个生物实体造成分解伤害。
description.en_us: Deals server-scaled disassembly damage to one verified living entity within the selected range.

description.zh_cn: 依次对实体集合中的有限目标执行解构；目标数与功率受配置限制，每个目标仍独立接受距离、友伤与资源校验。
description.en_us: Disassembles a bounded number of entities in list order; every target still receives independent range, friendly-fire, and resource validation.

description.zh_cn: 施放该分类的能力时，从此处启动该能力分类的程序。
description.en_us: Starts this ability category's program when an ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 读取当前 α、β、激活中的 γ 相位强度，以及未元物质总量与有效容量。
description.en_us: Reads current alpha, beta, active gamma power, total dark matter, and effective capacity.

description.zh_cn: 返回正在执行此未元物质精密操作的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this Darkmatter program.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者准星下的实体。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity under the caster's crosshair.

description.zh_cn: 对选中的生物实体造成电击伤害，并生成连接电弧。
description.en_us: Deals server-scaled electrical damage to the selected living entity and renders a connecting arc.

description.zh_cn: 按实体集合顺序连续放电，后续电弧逐跳衰减，并受最大跳跃次数限制。
description.en_us: Discharges through entities in list order with per-jump attenuation and a configurable jump limit.

description.zh_cn: 为配置的实体或方块持续充能 10 tick；无 FE 能量槽的方块会获得同等时长的红石信号。
description.en_us: Charges the configured entity or block for 10 ticks; a block without FE storage receives a redstone signal instead.

description.zh_cn: 牵引时将磁性实体加入清单并移向坐标；发射时沿目标坐标射出、伤害轨迹实体并解除控制。方块目标在此明确拒绝，请改用结构节点族。
description.en_us: Pull adds a magnetic entity to the controlled roster and moves it; launch fires it toward the destination, damages entities along the path, and releases it. Block targets are rejected here and use the structure node family instead.

description.zh_cn: 为选中的整结构取得本程序的独占控制。后续单体动作连接“结构控制”端口；结构集合动作会自行取得并释放控制，无须逐个调用本节点。结构被占用、已卸载或已断裂失效时操作失败。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Acquire exclusive control of one whole structure for this program. Connect its Control output to single-structure actions. Group actions acquire and release their own control. Busy, unloaded or stale structures are rejected. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 对选中的宿主格执行磁性邻域提取，可显式启用付费、有期限的强制磁化覆盖。结构输出仅在内容事务提交后发布；进行中、空选区、非磁性、被占、超预算与权限不足均返回机器可读的明确结果并保留源方块。
description.en_us: Starts the magnetic-neighbourhood extraction on the selected host block, optionally under the paid, time-limited forced-magnetization overlay. The structure output appears only after the content transaction committed; pending, empty, non-magnetic, occupied, over-budget and permission failures are reported as explicit machine-readable results and keep the source blocks.

label.zh_cn: 格数预算（0 为后端默认）
label.en_us: Cell budget (0 is the backend default)

description.zh_cn: 从已取得的控制权沿输入方向施加一次有界发射。伤害只在飞行中的真实接触处结算，绝不沿预设轨迹提前结算；发射后撤销本次磁场与磁化覆盖，结构及其运动保留。
description.en_us: Releases one bounded launch along the supplied direction from control that already holds the body. Damage is settled only at real contacts during flight, never along a preset trajectory; the field and magnetization overlay are withdrawn afterwards while the structure and its motion are retained.

description.zh_cn: 向世界目标坐标持续施力；可选局部锚点指定结构上的作用位置，不接目标时保持该锚点当前的位置。持续秒数优先使用输入端口，其次使用配置。等待施力窗口结束后继续，并回传原控制供后续动作使用。实际位移取决于质量、碰撞和推力。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Apply force toward a world destination. An optional local anchor chooses the point on the structure; without a destination, hold that anchor at its initial world position. The Seconds input overrides the configured duration. Wait for the force window, then pass the original Control to the next action. Motion depends on mass, collisions and available force. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。选取最多 8 个空闲结构，为各成员设置“初始质心＋世界位移”目标并同时施力。位移最长 64 格，持续 0.1–10 秒；秒数输入优先于配置，开始后固定目标与时长。等待施力窗口结束后释放控制，输出原结构集合供后续动作使用；保留惯性，到达位置由实际物理运动决定。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。 不接位移时默认沿视线引导 3 格，默认持续 1 秒。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Apply force to at most 8 free structures, targeting each initial center of mass plus the world displacement. Maximum distance: 64 blocks; duration: 0.1–10 seconds. Seconds overrides the configuration; targets and duration are captured once. Wait for the force window, release control, then output the original set. Inertia remains and physical motion determines the final position. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action. With no displacement input, guide 3 blocks along the caster’s view for the default 1 second.

description.zh_cn: 结束本控制句柄的持续施力与姿态命令，保留结构、线速度和角速度。重复释放无额外效果；后续需要控制时重新取得，不会影响接替本句柄的新控制。
description.en_us: Stop this control handle’s force and attitude commands while preserving the structure and its linear and angular velocity. Repeated release has no additional effect. Acquire a new handle for later actions; a successor’s control is preserved.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别按配置回正。自动取得控制，等待全组完成后释放，并输出原结构集合。各成员分别使用自己的创建姿态；任一成员失效或受阻时结束全组。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Right up to 8 free structures independently using the configured reference. Acquire control automatically, wait for all members, release control, then output the original set. Each member uses its own creation attitude. Stop if any member becomes invalid or obstructed. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 按配置回到世界竖直方向或创建时的姿态；创建姿态不可用时按配置失败或改用世界网格。等待回正后继续，并回传原控制。超时、受阻或控制失效时结束操作。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Return to world upright or the structure’s creation attitude. If the creation attitude is unavailable, reject or use the world grid as configured. Wait until finished, then pass on the original Control. Stop on timeout, obstruction or lost control. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 将结构转向输入的世界绝对姿态；姿态由旋转轴与弧度角构造。受力矩和碰撞约束，等待达到目标后继续，并回传原控制供下一动作使用。只控制朝向，不负责抬升或悬停。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Turn the structure toward the world-absolute attitude constructed from an axis and an angle in radians. Wait until reached, then pass the original Control output to the next action. Torque and collision limits apply. This action controls attitude without providing lift or hovering. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别转向同一世界绝对姿态。自动取得控制，等待全组完成后释放，并输出原结构集合；每体独立绕质心旋转，不绕群组中心公转。任一成员失效或受阻时结束全组。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。 不接姿态时默认转向世界 Y 轴 90°。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Turn up to 8 free structures to the same world-absolute attitude. Acquire control automatically, wait for all members, release control, then output the original set. Each rotates about its own center of mass. Stop the group if any member becomes invalid or obstructed. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action. With no attitude input, use an absolute 90° rotation about world Y.

description.zh_cn: 按世界轴或结构自身轴旋转指定时间；正负角速度决定旋转方向，单位为弧度/秒。服务器上限为每秒 2 弧度、58 秒。结束时按配置制动或保留惯性，再回传原控制；不负责悬停。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。
description.en_us: Rotate about a world axis or the structure’s local axis. Signed angular speed sets direction in radians per second. Server limits: 2 rad/s and 58 seconds. Brake or preserve inertia as configured, then pass on the original Control. No hovering is provided. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action.

description.zh_cn: 可直接使用：只接流程时控制准星结构，也可接单结构或结构集合。最多 8 个空闲结构分别绕世界轴或自身局部轴持续旋转。自动取得控制，在结束时按配置制动或保留惯性，随后释放并输出原结构集合；每体分别计费，不提供队形约束或悬停。 须有有效磁性参与；临时磁化到期会终止动作。 不接旋转轴时默认世界向上；默认每秒 1 弧度，持续 1 秒。
description.en_us: Basic use: connect Flow to control the looked-at structure, or supply one Structure or a Structure Set. Spin up to 8 free structures independently about a world or local axis. Acquire control automatically, brake or preserve inertia as configured, then release and output the original set. Costs apply per member; formation and hovering are not provided. Valid magnetic participation is required; temporary magnetization expiry stops the action. The default axis is world up, at 1 rad/s for 1 second.

description.zh_cn: 检查结构能否按当前朝向还原到世界方块网格。目标必须已加载、可放置且具有权限；当前版本只提供检查，尚不执行还原。使用“释放结构控制”可结束能力控制并保留物理结构。
description.en_us: Check whether the structure can align with the world block grid at its current attitude. The destination must be loaded, placeable and permitted. This version only checks conditions; restoration is not yet available. Release Structure Control ends ability control while preserving the physical structure.

description.zh_cn: 施放该分类的能力时，从此处启动该能力分类的程序。
description.en_us: Starts this ability category's program when an ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 按配置的实体/方块、上下限和 FE 百分比返回检测结果。
description.en_us: Checks configured entity/block FE percentage against the selected upper or lower threshold.

description.zh_cn: 按配置的上下限与 0–15 红石充能等级返回检测结果。
description.en_us: Checks the block's 0–15 redstone power against the selected upper or lower threshold.

description.zh_cn: 读取实体或方块的 FE 百分比，并标示目标是否具有可识别的能量存储。
description.en_us: Reads an entity or block's FE percentage and reports whether recognizable energy storage is present.

description.zh_cn: 返回正在执行该电击使精密操作的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this Electromaster program.

description.zh_cn: 收集指定世界坐标半径内具有 FE 能量槽的已加载方块坐标。
description.en_us: Collects loaded block positions with FE storage within the supplied radius.

description.zh_cn: 返回经服务端验证的能力者准星所指实体。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity under the caster's crosshair.

description.zh_cn: 感知指定坐标半径内可被磁力操控的实体、掉落物、装备携带者与下落方块。
description.en_us: Senses magnetically controllable entities, items, equipped carriers, and falling blocks around a position.

description.zh_cn: 施放能力时从此处启动程序。
description.en_us: Starts the program when the ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 保留仍存活且未被移除的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities that are alive and not removed.

description.zh_cn: 按照队伍与友伤保护保留友方实体。
description.en_us: Keeps allies according to teams and friendly-fire protection.

description.zh_cn: 保留与能力者距离不超过设定值的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities within the selected distance of the caster.

description.zh_cn: 保留能力者以外的非友方实体。
description.en_us: Keeps non-allied entities other than the caster.

description.zh_cn: 保留符合所选大类的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities matching the selected broad entity type.

description.zh_cn: 保留当前拥有有效攻击目标的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities that currently have an effective target.

description.zh_cn: 保留生命百分比不低于设定值的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities at or above the selected health percentage.

description.zh_cn: 保留生命百分比不高于设定值的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities at or below the selected health percentage.

description.zh_cn: 保留被判定为敌对指定实体的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities judged hostile to the supplied entity.

description.zh_cn: 保留最近被指定攻击者伤害的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities most recently damaged by the supplied attacker.

description.zh_cn: 保留有效攻击目标为指定实体的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities whose effective target is the supplied entity.

description.zh_cn: 使用服务端视线判定保留指定观察者可见的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities visible to the supplied observer using server line of sight.

description.zh_cn: 主体位于能力者指定距离内时执行成立分支。
description.en_us: Takes the true branch when the subject is within the selected distance of the caster.

description.zh_cn: 主体符合所选实体大类时执行成立分支。
description.en_us: Takes the true branch when the subject matches the selected broad entity type.

description.zh_cn: 主体生命比例不高于阈值时执行成立分支。
description.en_us: Takes the true branch when the subject's health ratio is at or below the threshold.

description.zh_cn: 主体当前具有至少一个状态效果时执行成立分支。
description.en_us: Takes the true branch when the subject currently has at least one status effect.

description.zh_cn: 在目标实体处向输入方向发射高速电子束；该实体免疫此束伤害并被向反方向推进。
description.en_us: Fires a high-speed electron beam from the target entity, excludes it from beam damage, and pushes it opposite the firing direction.

description.zh_cn: 在输入世界坐标生成被固定于波粒二象性间不稳定状态的高速电子束，并向输入方向或目标坐标发射；可分别配置方块破坏与敌对弹射物摧毁。
description.en_us: Spawns a high-speed electron beam at the supplied world position and aims it by direction or target position; block and hostile projectile destruction are configurable independently.

description.zh_cn: 以中心束和环形偏转束组成电子扇面；每束独立消耗资源，并可按配置破坏方块。
description.en_us: Forms a fan from one central beam and a ring of deflected beams; each beam costs resources independently and may destroy blocks.

description.zh_cn: 在输入世界坐标生成采掘束，并向输入方向或目标坐标发射。
description.en_us: Spawns a mining beam at the supplied world position and fires it toward a direction or target position.

description.zh_cn: 施放该分类的能力时，从此处启动该能力分类的程序。
description.en_us: Starts this ability category's program when an ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 返回正在执行此原子崩坏精密操作的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this Meltdowner program.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者准星下的实体。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity under the caster's crosshair.

description.zh_cn: 结束能力者当前的心灵潜入会话。
description.en_us: Ends the caster's active Mental Intrusion session.

description.zh_cn: 使受控实体持续跟随目标实体或驻守地点，并攻击威胁目标、能力者或其盟友的敌人。
description.en_us: Keeps controlled subjects near an entity or place and attacks threats to the target, caster, or caster allies.

description.zh_cn: 使所选主体将能力者视为友方。
description.en_us: Makes the selected subjects treat the caster as an ally.

description.zh_cn: 对所选主体施加呆然自失。
description.en_us: Applies Mental Stupor to the selected subjects.

description.zh_cn: 命令受支持的主体向指定目标寻路。允许能力者自身；能力者主动移动、转向、攻击或使用物品会中断自身效果。
description.en_us: Orders supported subjects to path toward the supplied target. The caster may be a subject; moving, turning, attacking, or using an item interrupts the caster's own effect.

description.zh_cn: 使观察者无法感知被隐藏实体。
description.en_us: Prevents the observers from perceiving the hidden entity.

description.zh_cn: 解除所选主体的介入编队与精密操作控制，并阻止其在离开召回范围前被自动重新加入。
description.en_us: Releases the selected subjects from the intervention roster and Precision Operation control, suppressing automatic recall until they leave recall range.

description.zh_cn: 对指定目标开始心灵潜入。
description.en_us: Starts Mental Intrusion on the supplied target.

description.zh_cn: 强制主体将指定实体识别为攻击目标。
description.en_us: Forces the subjects to identify the supplied entity as their target.

description.zh_cn: 命令受支持的主体看向指定目标。允许能力者自身；能力者主动移动、转向、攻击或使用物品会中断自身效果。
description.en_us: Orders supported subjects to look at the supplied target. The caster may be a subject; moving, turning, attacking, or using an item interrupts the caster's own effect.

description.zh_cn: 保留能力者受控清单内或当前存在心理控制租约的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities in the caster's roster or with an active mental-control lease.

description.zh_cn: 保留支持指定心理控制能力的实体。
description.en_us: Keeps entities supporting the selected mental-control capability.

description.zh_cn: 返回当前心灵潜入观察目标。
description.en_us: Returns the current Mental Intrusion observation target.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者当前控制的实体集合。
description.en_us: Returns the caster's currently controlled entities.

description.zh_cn: 返回执行当前程序的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this program.

description.zh_cn: 返回指定实体当前的有效攻击目标。
description.en_us: Returns the supplied entity's effective current target.

description.zh_cn: 根据起点 A 与目标 B 的当前位置，输出由 A 指向 B 的单位方向。
description.en_us: Outputs the normalized direction from position A to position B.

description.zh_cn: 读取实体当前所在位置并输出固定位置目标。
description.en_us: Reads an entity's current location and outputs a fixed-position destination.

description.zh_cn: 返回最近伤害指定主体的生物实体。
description.en_us: Returns the living entity that most recently hurt the subject.

description.zh_cn: 返回服务端校验的 64 格准星下生物实体。
description.en_us: Returns the living entity under the server-verified crosshair up to 64 blocks away.

description.zh_cn: 收集能力者指定范围内的全部实体，不包含能力者。
description.en_us: Collects every entity in range of the caster, excluding the caster.

description.zh_cn: 收集能力者指定范围内的掉落物实体。
description.en_us: Collects dropped-item entities in range of the caster.

description.zh_cn: 收集能力者指定范围内的生物实体。
description.en_us: Collects living entities within the selected range of the caster.

description.zh_cn: 收集能力者指定范围内的弹射物实体。
description.en_us: Collects projectile entities in range of the caster.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者最近攻击的存活实体。
description.en_us: Returns the last living entity attacked by the caster.

description.zh_cn: 沿输入方向将起点偏移设定距离，输出新的固定位置目标。
description.en_us: Offsets the origin along the supplied direction and outputs a new fixed-position destination.

description.zh_cn: 从指定实体进行 64 格视线射线检测；实体命中会动态跟随，方块命中输出命中面外侧地点。
description.en_us: Server-raycasts up to 64 blocks from the observer; entity hits stay dynamic while block hits use the outside face position.

description.zh_cn: 放置模式将指定快捷栏或手持物传送至方块坐标，破坏原方块并以方块硬度×10或武器伤害作为原始伤害打击重叠实体。对生物的基础伤害取“原始伤害与最大 CP 上限的较小值”和“目标最大生命值的 5%”中的较高值；增伤在此后结算。传送方块的消耗为 min(方块硬度, 最大 CP 上限÷10)+10 CP，非方块物品按其武器伤害等比例计算；收取模式固定消耗 10 CP，破坏方块并将该格掉落物立即收入背包。
description.en_us: Place mode teleports the chosen hotbar or held item to a block position, breaks the existing block, and uses block hardness ×10 or weapon damage as raw damage against overlapping entities. Base damage to living targets is the greater of raw damage limited by maximum CP and 5% of target maximum health; damage bonuses apply afterward. Teleporting a block costs min(block hardness, maximum CP÷10)+10 CP; non-block items scale equivalently from weapon damage. Collect costs 10 CP, breaks the block, and moves drops in that cell into the inventory.

description.zh_cn: 传送实体、方块或完整物理结构，可用朝向输入调整目标方向。结构以质心落到目标世界坐标，并保留内容与运动；仅支持同维度、全部已加载且没有碰撞的落点，已被控制的结构不能传送。
description.en_us: Teleport an entity, a block or a whole physical structure; an optional facing input adjusts its orientation. Structures place their center of mass at the world destination while preserving content and motion. Requires the same dimension, a fully loaded collision-free destination, and no active structure control.

description.zh_cn: 将能力者安全传送至任意距离、任意可用维度中的无碰撞目标位置。
description.en_us: Safely teleports the caster to a collision-free destination at any distance in any available dimension.

description.zh_cn: 施放该分类的能力时，从此处启动该能力分类的程序。
description.en_us: Starts this ability category's program when an ability is cast.

description.zh_cn: 检测实体精确放置在输入世界坐标时是否无方块碰撞、挤压或世界边界冲突。
description.en_us: Checks whether the entity can occupy the exact world position without collision, crushing, or world-border conflict.

description.zh_cn: 返回正在执行此传送使精密操作的玩家。
description.en_us: Returns the player executing this Teleport program.

description.zh_cn: 返回能力者准星下的实体。
description.en_us: Returns the server-verified entity under the caster's crosshair.
